records.title: Hierarchical Graph Transformer with Adaptive Node Sampling
records.reason: The method reduces complexity for graph transformers by adaptive node sampling and hierarchical attention over graph nodes; this is not LLM token inference/serving.

records.title: Natural-Language Agent Harnesses
records.reason: Natural-language agent harnesses make policy documents compact, but primary experiments report more model/tool calls or tokens than specialized code harnesses; net inference-resource savings are unproven.

records.title: Rethinking Rubric Generation for Improving LLM Judge and Reward Modeling for Open-ended Tasks
records.reason: Recursive rubric decomposition improves LLM judge/reward-model evaluation quality; it does not optimize inference compute, memory, latency, or serving.

records.title: Performance-Efficiency Trade-Offs in Unsupervised Pre-Training for Speech Recognition
records.reason: Primary abstract: speech-recognition unsupervised pretraining and training-efficiency trade-offs, not LLM inference.

records.title: Lumina-Next: Making Lumina-T2X Stronger and Faster with Next-DiT
records.reason: Next-DiT accelerates/strengthens text-to-image/video diffusion generation, not LLM language inference or serving.
